description: This file contains shell script tests for git push operations, including various scenarios such as normal push, atomic push, non-fast-forward push, forced push, and cleanup operations, with detailed output formatting and reference comparisons.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided shell commands, and compares output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure, runs the provided shell commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares reference states between local and remote repositories.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats and saves expected output for comparison.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes raw output into a user-friendly, stable format.

methods.name: filter_out_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Filters specific lines from output for comparison.
